hits.snippet: Today Nozomi Networks announced that my co-founder, Andrea Carcano, is returning as CEO of Nozomi Networks. Andrea and I started this company in 2013 with one conviction: the industrial world deserved better security than anything that existed. We wrote the first lines of code together. A few years in, we asked Edgard Capdevielle to help us take it to the world - and he did exactly that. A platform trusted by the operators who run critical infrastructure. A company recognized as the leader in its category. A set of milestones very few startups ever reach. Thank you, Edgard. I learned a great deal from you, and I am glad you are staying close to us as an advisor. Now the ground is shifting again. AI is changing how vulnerabilities are found and how defenses are built, faster than anything I have seen in my career. Leading through that will take real research and development depth, not louder marketing. That is why Andrea in this seat is the right decision for the next chapter of Nozomi, and why he has my full support. Two founders, doing what we have always done. The work continues. Back to building.#OTSecurity#IoTSecurity#CriticalInfrastructure#AI
